requirements.requirement: The system must include a composite_score field in the FastAPI response model for provider evaluation outputs.
The system must include a component_measures field in the response containing at least 3 individual measure scores used in the composite.
The system must ensure the composite_score value returned via API matches exactly the value produced by the scoring engine for identical inputs.
The system must serialize the scoring fields using valid Pydantic response models defined in the FastAPI layer.
The system must include scoring fields in tool_router outputs so that downstream chat consumers receive the same data as the API response.
The system must preserve backward compatibility by not removing or renaming existing provider response fields.
The system must return composite_score as a numeric type within a bounded range (0 to 100 inclusive).
The system must return component_measures as a structured object with named measures and numeric values.
The system must include scoring fields only when scoring data is available from the EvaluateCare facade.
The system must return a null composite_score and empty component_measures when scoring fails gracefully without breaking the API response.
The system must return a 500 error response when scoring integration produces an unhandled exception during response construction.
The system must ensure response JSON is valid and parseable by frontend clients when scoring fields are included.
